fixture: Real Chrome with canonical ATC source, React host contract, and test-only gameRef access.

checks.name: Guided practice starts paused and only adds arrivals when requested
Speed form freezes all flight state and validates the full teaching range
Heading 360 normalizes to north and restores focus after the form closes
Manual climb cancels automatic descent and then stacks manual altitude steps
Manual go-around is counted and discards the old touchdown flag
Holding aircraft continue moving and a manual heading releases the hold
Controls help freezes the running shift and resumes it when closed
Movement and fuel consumption share the same accelerated flight-time units
Radar shortcuts respect browser modifier keys
Radar click selection remains correct after desktop and narrow-screen resizing
Priority and ETA order, projected spacing, and tight runway gaps render together
A pending math challenge freezes aircraft and stays readable during resize
Go-around count persists into the shift review
Flight strips and instructions continue when no 2D rendering context is available
No uncaught browser errors or native prompt dialogs
